exact_statement: Let G=a+sigma*b*h be any Boolean coherent wrapper on disjoint finite uniform cubes, a in {-1,0,1}, b=1-a^2, sigma=+/-1, with ANY normalized finite-cost seed source R having R(empty)=(Eh)^2. Supply the full coherent reference Q(U,empty)=(ahat(U)+sigma*Eh*bhat(U))^2 and Q(U,T)=bhat(U)^2 R(T) for nonempty T. At a physical seed query j put d=hhat({j}), r=R({j}), beta=sum bhat^2, E=sum bhat^4, C=sum ahat^2 bhat^2, D=sum ahat bhat^3, Gamma=C-D^2/E if E>0 and0 otherwise. Set x=Gamma*d^2+(E+beta^2)(r-d^2)^2/4. BOTH actual child coherent-block calibration refunds have average at least2x/ln2. In each child of positive actual tail mass t, changing the CURRENT normalized nonempty seed profile M to(1-epsilon)M+epsilon*S for ANY prescribed nonempty probability law S, epsilon=x/(t+x) if x>0, costs at most x/ln2. Zero-tail/zero-energy children use explicit unchanged-tail endpoints. The full erasure-plus-mean-child-CE transaction releases at least rho+x/ln2, where rho is the actual conditional-occupancy KL. Therefore any finite adaptive sequence at this scope preserves the SAME supplied original rate and all old debits/full terminals. At beta>0,d=0,r>0 the authorization is positive, while exact-source parity with d=r=0 remains unpaid for a prescribed positive reset. Fixed A079 controller has x=(9/3584)d^2+(93/2048)(r-d^2)^2. No initial universal influence-priced source or fixed-strength all-query conversion is supplied.
